movie.title: Dolly
movie.overview: Young Macy is abducted by a deranged, monstrous figure who wants to raise her as its child.

reviews.author: graeaehorror
reviews.content:
Based on the segment Baby Girl from Horror Anthology Volume 1, Dolly is a brutal independent feature that’s getting a cinematic release on 6th March. 

Director Rod Blackhurst has done this indie short proud, giving us a real tour de force of horror which proves the genre is not dependent on remakes and sequels alone. This is pure, unapologetic terror with a grindhouse feel and visuals that hark back to the golden age of horror. There are homages to rage fuelled classics we all adore and has a gritty intense vibe that Tobe Hooper would be proud of.

Not satisfied with being a true powerhouse in the pro-wrestling world, Max The Impaler invades our nightmares as Dolly with an emotional and terrifying performance. Fabienne Therese is giving every ounce of final girl energy as Macy and I’m so here for it! Seann William Scott and Ethan Suplee each portray strong characters and are a joy to watch.

With jaw dropping practical effects, a fantastic score and unrelenting pacing, Dolly has to be an early contender for best independent feature of 2026. You’d best support this film in cinemas else Dolly is coming to get ya!

reviews.author: Sierbahnn
reviews.content: This is a very decent and average slasher movie in which the protagonists are interesting enough for you to engage with, and the antagonist is without too much backstory, which means that you can't empathize or predict what they're going to do. It's not quite as effective in this regard as something like The Hitchhiker, but it is certainly a lot better than the antagonists in something like Scream. The antagonist is absolutely the main draw here and is very creepy and unsettling. The unfolding narrative around the titular antagonist is captivating enough, and the movie is shot very proficiently. It doesn't elevate itself, and I don't think it aspires to, but it is certainly good enough. And if you like these movies, you'll have a good time.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: During a remote hiking trip in the wilderness, young Macy is violently abducted by a deranged, doll-masked figure who traps her in an isolated home and forces her to act as its child.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: A romantic getaway into the mountains turns into a horrific nightmare when Macy and her boyfriend cross into the territory of a masked, disturbed recluse known as Dolly. After her partner is brutally attacked and left for dead, Macy is kidnapped and taken to an isolated, doll-strewn house in the woods. There, her captor treats her like an infant, forcing her into disturbing games of simulated parenthood. Trapped in a sickening survival struggle, Macy must play along while desperately searching for a way to escape.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Macy sets off on what is intended to be a peaceful hiking getaway with her boyfriend, Chase, in a remote forested region. However, their journey takes a sinister turn when they stray onto forbidden land and discover eerie vintage dolls abandoned throughout the woods. They are soon ambushed by a imposing, masked figure—a deeply disturbed recluse operating under the persona 'Dolly'. Chase is swiftly incapacitated and left behind, leaving Macy entirely at the killer's mercy. Abducted and brought to a decaying house filled with dingy floral wallpaper and endless toys, Macy realizes the figure intends to raise her as its baby. Subjected to bizarre, gag-inducing rituals and psychological torment, Macy must feign obedience to gain her captor's trust. Every moment inside the house becomes a tightrope walk between gruesome punishment and subtle acts of resistance. Knowing the fate of the figure's previous captives, Macy uses every ounce of cunning and resolve to orchestrate a desperate break for freedom.
aiEnrichment.synopsis:
Dolly is a intense psychological horror-thriller centered on Macy, a young woman who embarks on a secluded nature trip with her partner, only to fall prey to a nightmare lurking in the forest. Deep within the wilderness, the couple unwittingly enters the hunting grounds of an eerie, doll-masked recluse. Following a sudden and violent encounter, Macy is separated from her boyfriend and dragged to a claustrophobic, dirt-strewn lair decorated like a distorted nursery.

Her kidnapper, driven by a violent delusion, forces Macy into the role of a helpless infant, demanding complete submission in exchange for her life. As Macy navigates the disturbing environment and the terrifying mood swings of her captor, she realizes that brute force won't be enough to survive. Blending relentless backwoods dread with tense, mind-game survival, the film follows Macy's horrifying ordeal as she struggles to retain her sanity and find a path toward escape.

story_structure.climax: A volatile confrontation erupts when Macy makes a desperate, high-stakes bid for freedom, facing her captor head-on in a fight for her life.
story_structure.conflict: Macy finds herself trapped in captivity by a deranged captor who insists on raising her as its own child, forcing her into a desperate psychological and physical struggle for survival.
story_structure.resolution: The ordeal draws to a close as the immediate threat is resolved, leaving Macy to begin the long journey toward safety, healing, and reclaiming her life.
story_structure.introduction: Young Macy is introduced in her daily life before her safety is shattered by a terrifying, unprovoked abduction.
story_structure.risingAction: As the captor's unsettling delusions intensify, Macy must carefully navigate the unpredictable rules of her imprisonment, seeking opportunities to outwit her captor and signal for help while enduring worsening conditions.
